mentions.name: Movie Character Lookalike Finder
mentions.description: A browser-based tool that uses face-api to match your face with the movie character you look most like. All processing runs locally in the browser, with no data sent to a server.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A tool that uses face-api to find the movie character you look the most like. Everything runs in browser, without any data being sent to the server.

https://movie.jammaloo.com/
